description:
This is a Addon to Yuoki-Industries !
More Informations and Discussion -> https://forums.factorio.com/viewforum.php?f=70

please notice: this Addon is for experiencend Yuoki-Industry Players and add new recipes. The goal is to build good and profitable Trade-Clusters. It aim's more at mid-/endgame and is more a puzzle-game or special challenge !
Produced/Crafted Goods are mostly not useable, because they are designed for trade !

It is possible to build cycles that grow from Trade-Profit.

Don't forget the fun until you play :)

0.4.15
- still unfinished, but now aviable at mods.factorio.com
